top_signals.title: Microsoft Patches a Record 570 Security Flaws
top_signals.summary: Microsoft Corp. today released software updates to plug at least 570 security holes in its Windows operating systems and other software, almost triple the number of vulnerabilities the software giant fixed in its record-smashing Patch Tuesday release last month. Microsoft attributed the burgeoning patch counts to vulnerability discoveries aided by artificial intelligence.

top_signals.title: South Africa’s Rand Faces Bleak August as Policy Stance Queried
top_signals.summary: August is historically the rand’s worst month, and traders expect this year to be no different as questions about the central bank’s policy stance add to seasonal woes for South Africa’s currency.

top_signals.title: UK’s Markets Regulator Unveils Scope of Data Feed for Stocks
top_signals.summary: The UK Financial Conduct Authority unveiled how much data it will allow to be published on UK equities trading on Friday, a move that could encourage more activity on the London Stock Exchange.
